# appraisal of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:appraisalOf`](gmeow-appraisalOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/appraisalOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

What is appraised — an agent's state, a work, an event, an emotion (⊑ [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), the bridge idiom). Range intentionally open. Functional: one appraisal, one subject.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Appraisal`](../classes/gmeow-Appraisal.md) -> `?`; functional
